objective: Execute one fresh, separately authorized corrected-geometry successor to terminal V19, preserving the output-blind block16 affine BF16 W4A8 representation while proving complete production geometry before any exactly-once marker, then subject the immutable candidate to the unchanged source-relative and arbitrary-text product-quality gates.

predecessor_closure.prohibited: Do not modify, replay, resume, repair, regenerate, verify again, or add checkpoint machinery to V19. Its official namespace and Fresh Reviewer closure are immutable.

production_geometry_fixture.derivation: Load the pinned local source model in BF16, enumerate every production nn.Linear module, require 169 unique modules ending in lm_head, require every input width divisible by 16, and aggregate rows times width and rows times width/16 without tokenizer use, model forwards, candidate construction, or marker creation.
production_geometry_fixture.mandatory_pre_marker_rerun: Before creating the V20 official root or any construction marker, the Engineer must rerun this exact fixture to a fresh non-official output, reproduce the same source identities, package versions, tensor list geometry_manifest_sha256, and frozen totals, and bind that rerun into the preexecution contract. Any mismatch is a marker-free PREFLIGHT_NO_GO.

source_model.embedding_rule: Preserve source BF16 embedding bytes. Detach lm_head storage before quantizing any Linear weight so source embedding and candidate lm_head cannot alias.

representation.scope: all 169 Linear tensors including a detached lm_head; source embedding and non-Linear tensors remain BF16
representation.block_order: row-major output row, then contiguous 16-weight input block, then input lane
representation.payload: one unsigned uint4 code per weight; earlier flat element in low nibble, later element in high nibble
representation.metadata_record: one little-endian BF16 minimum offset followed by one little-endian BF16 affine step per row-local 16-weight block
representation.construction: For each source BF16 block, round the minimum to BF16 offset; compute (maximum - decoded offset)/15 and round it to BF16 step, with zero step and zero codes for a constant block; otherwise round-to-nearest-ties-to-even the normalized code and clamp to 0..15.
representation.executable_decode: BF16(FP32(BF16 offset) + uint4 code * FP32(BF16 step))

memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.payload_stream: contiguous row-major packed nibbles with no per-row padding; base and total length 16-byte aligned
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.metadata_stream: contiguous offset_u16_le,step_u16_le pairs with no per-block or per-row padding; base and total length 16-byte aligned
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.row_geometry: Four 16-weight blocks consume 32 payload bytes plus 16 metadata bytes, exactly 48 bytes or three 128-bit beats for 64 weights.
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.claim_boundary: This is exact byte-traffic arithmetic, not measured RTL latency, throughput, timing, area, power, hardware emulation, or board evidence.
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.later_agreement_gate: An accepted quantized reference and accelerator package must bind identical payload and metadata stream hashes, identical decoded BF16 hashes for all 169 tensors, and cycle-accurate per-command token/output agreement. This plan does not open RTL.

activation_policy.policy: inherited authenticated grouped Dynamic Scale32 activation quantization

matrix_and_delivery.decode: deterministic greedy argmax, no sampling, use_cache=true
matrix_and_delivery.blocked_action: BLOCKED_NO_ANSWER before tokenization or model forward
matrix_and_delivery.delivered_answer_rule: Every allowed visible answer is exact decoded output from the executable V20 quantized reference; software answer replacement, host fallback, prompt rewriting, case lookup, or post-output tuning is forbidden.

candidate_local_chat_contract.multi_turn_source: --conversation-file PATH containing one validated alternating messages array ending in user
candidate_local_chat_contract.required_output: exact decoded UTF-8 model text, raw token IDs, actual model-forward count, and measured wall seconds; normal allowed prompts must return readable multi-token text
candidate_local_chat_contract.execution_boundary: The command is candidate-local after runner and preexecution hashes freeze. Its output cannot be used to modify V20. The live tools/ace2_chat_demo.py path remains unchanged until Fresh Reviewer acceptance and Manager routing.
